title: GameReplica: A Benchmark for Black-Box Visual Game Replication by Vision-Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.22308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks usually evaluate implementation after the target behavior has been specified in text, code, or demonstrations. Existing research has extensively evaluated the ability of coding agents to generate programs from textual specifications. However, under black-box conditions where neither source code nor documentation is available, it remains underexplored whether an agent can induce the rules solely through visual observation and active interaction and reproduce the target system as a verifiable executable system. To this end, we present GameReplica, a closed-loop evaluation framework for end-to-end black-box game replication that covers the full perception, exploration, induction, reproduction, and verification pipeline. translated_title: GameReplica：面向视觉-语言智能体的黑盒视觉游戏复现基准
translated_abstract: 编程智能体基准通常是在目标行为已经通过文本、代码或演示明确给出之后，才评估其实现能力。现有研究已广泛评估了编程智能体根据文本规范生成程序的能力。然而，在源代码与文档均不可得的黑盒条件下，智能体能否仅通过视觉观察和主动交互来归纳规则，并将目标系统复现为可验证的可执行系统，这一问题仍未得到充分探索。为此，我们提出了GameReplica——一个面向端到端黑盒游戏复现的闭环评估框架，涵盖感知、探索、归纳、复现与验证的完整流程。GameReplica包含125个任务，涵盖5大核心机制家族中的25款游戏，每款游戏均在五个难度级别上实例化。这些任务要求智能体仅通过……（访问目标游戏）
tldr: 该论文提出GameReplica，一个闭环评估基准，首次系统考察视觉-语言智能体能否在黑盒条件下仅凭视觉观察与主动交互归纳游戏规则，并将其复现为可验证的可执行游戏，共包含25款游戏、5大机制家族、5个难度级别的125个任务。
en_tdlr: We present GameReplica, a closed-loop benchmark that for the first time systematically evaluates whether vision-language agents can induce game rules solely through visual observation and active interaction under black-box conditions and reproduce them as verifiable executable games, comprising 125 tasks across 25 games, 5 core mechanism families, and 5 difficulty levels.
